page.content:
Armored night-mare form of Princess Luna who tries to bring eternal night.

How Nightmare Moon connects

  • Character: Princess Luna — Nightmare Moon is Princess Luna's armored exile-self.
  • Faction: Mane Six — The Mane Six use the Elements of Harmony against Nightmare Moon.

What is Nightmare Moon?

Nightmare Moon is Luna's bitter, armored self from the two-part premiere, the tyrant the Mane Six defeat with the Elements of Harmony so Luna can come home to Canterlot.

Key threads lead to Princess Luna and Mane Six.
